name: ops_dag
summary: The deterministic operational DAG. Auto-walks studio/assets/_agents/agent_defs/ (22 cards), studio/assets/_workflows/ (1 card → 8 passes), and studio/assets/_operations/text_placeholders.json (13 future ops). Emits 43 nodes + 59 edges to ~/.cc/ops_dag.jsonl. Topo sort gives optimal execution order. Parallel groups show what can run concurrently. text_placeholders are first-class nodes that retroactively activate when implementations land.
engine_pattern: pure-Python graph builder. Kahn topological sort. Level-based parallel detection. BFS path queries. ParserCursor-compatible output.

node_kinds.agent: auto-built from each agent_def JSON in _agents/agent_defs/
node_kinds.pass: auto-built from each pass in each workflow_card in _workflows/

queries.build: walk all substrates → emit ~/.cc/ops_dag.jsonl + summary stats
queries.parallel: group by topological level → ops within a level can run concurrently
queries.placeholders: list every TEXT-PLACEHOLDER op (the 'retroactive active' surface)
queries.ready: ops whose ALL ordering deps are ACTIVE — these can be built NEXT

substrate: ops_dag (JSONL — joinable with all other chains via op_id == agent name)

inbound_callers: workflow_generator (future — verify card passes are realizable in current DAG state)
task_queue (future — pull next-ready ops to dispatch automatically)

guarantees: Deterministic — same substrate JSONs → same DAG bytes
Backward-compatible — placeholders integrate cleanly when their real implementations land (status flip + module_path update; edges stay)
Walkable — ParserCursor reads ~/.cc/ops_dag.jsonl identically to all other chains
Optimal scheduling — topo sort + parallel groups give a build order that respects all declared dependencies
Cross-substrate joinable — op_id maps directly to agent_def name; can join with crystal chain by name
the_text_placeholder_principle: A future op gets declared as TEXT-PLACEHOLDER with a description + expected_after + expected_before.
Downstream ops can reference it BEFORE it exists.
When the real implementation lands, its status flips ACTIVE and edges remain valid.
Result: forward-compatible architecture — you sketch the future and it actually wires up later.
usage_example:
cc ops-dag build       # rebuild after any agent_def or placeholder change
cc ops-dag ready       # show what's buildable right now
cc ops-dag parallel    # show what can run concurrently
cc ops-dag path op_tri_modal_embedder op_studio_marketplace
